sections.description: Pro add-on for Compath Choir Rehearsal: unlimited voice tracks, microphone recording, song search, editor Play preview, PDF score badges, and song library backup. Requires Lite (Compath Choir Rehearsal) installed and a valid SureCart license.
sections.changelog:
0.5.4

  • Check for plugin updates on the Choir Rehearsal Settings page also checks this Pro add-on
  • Clear the SureCart release cache and the WordPress update_plugins transient before looking for a new version
  • Compare the release with the installed plugin file, and keep the download link valid for 12 hours
  • If the license is not activated, say so without an error and without showing the license key or activation id

0.5.2

  • Pro License page: My orders.. opens the shop customer dashboard in a new tab
  • Deactivate License asks for confirmation before freeing the activation slot
  • Success and API error notices survive the redirect back to Pro License
  • HTTP 204 and other 2xx SureCart responses count as success
  • A failed deactivation keeps the saved license so it can be retried
  • A successful deactivation clears the activation id option and the license cache
  • Pro License page shows a masked activation ID and license key; deactivation uses the saved activation id

0.5.1

  • Store public SureCart license ids so song-list feedback can include them without the full license key

0.5.0

  • SureCart license activation (WordPress SDK)
  • Pro License settings under Choir Rehearsal
  • Feature unlock gated by active license
  • Automatic Pro updates via SureCart Current Release

0.4.49

  • Song library backup export/import
sections.frequently asked questions:
Where do I enter the license key?

In wp-admin go to Choir Rehearsal → Pro License. Paste the key from your shop.compath.ee customer dashboard and click Activate License.

Do I still need Lite?

Yes. Keep Compath Choir Rehearsal (Lite) installed and activate Pro beside it — do not replace Lite.
